title: Telemetry gateway error
description: What the gateway answers when a frame may not enter the platform. The shape matches the mission API's error contract, but the vocabulary is the gateway's own: these are communication faults, not mission faults. A refused frame is still recorded as received.

error.description: Sentence for the log. Senders key off code, never off this text.

details.description: Facts behind the refusal, present when the code has any.

sensor.description: Which value was out of range (VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE).

aheadSeconds.description: How far ahead of the gateway clock the measurement claimed to be (MEASURED_IN_FUTURE).

errorCode.description: STREAM_UNAVAILABLE: the gateway cannot publish, so it refuses rather than accepting what it cannot forward.
